summary.text: Zooey Zephyr is a Democratic state representative from Missoula who has represented Montana House District 95 since 2023 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working at the University of Montana.

paragraphs.text: Zooey Zephyr lives in Missoula, Montana, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working at the University of Montana.
She has served in the Montana House since 2023, and in the 2023-2024 session she chaired the House Legislative Administration Committee and served on the Human Services Committee.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the Human Services Committee.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for District 95.
